english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who designs things or does design professionally.
Use this broader term when focusing on the building designer's design role rather than specifically calling them an architect.

examples.english: That designer made a poster for me.
examples.traditional: 嗰個設計師幫我整咗張海報。
